questions.question_text: In 2016, Carla's salary was $23970 per year. From her salary she pays tax at a rate of 20%. She is paid monthly in equal amounts. Calculate the amount Carla receives each month after tax has been paid.
Carla's salary of $23970 was 2% more than her salary in 2015. Calculate her yearly salary in 2015.
From 2016, Carla's employer agrees to pay her an increase of 3% each year. Calculate the year in which her salary is first greater than $30000.
Reflection in the line y = x maps triangle A onto triangle B. Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle B onto triangle A.
Enlargement, with centre (2, 1) and scale factor 4, maps triangle C onto triangle D. Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle D onto triangle C.
Translation by the vector (-3 / 5) maps triangle E onto triangle F. Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle F onto triangle E.
Rotate triangle P through 90° anticlockwise about (0, 0). Label the image Q.
Stretch triangle P with stretch factor 2 and the y-axis invariant. Label the image R.
Complete the scatter diagram. The first four points have been plotted for you.
What type of correlation is shown on your scatter diagram?
Find the equation of the regression line, in the form y = mx + c.
Judge A gives another dancer a mark of 6.4. Use your equation to estimate the mark judge B gives this dancer.
Find the column vector 1/2 p.
Find the column vector q − 2p.
Find |p|, leaving your answer in surd form.
AB = p + q. Mark and label point B on the grid.
Nitini changes 119050 Indian rupees (INR) to Singapore dollars (SGD). The exchange rate is 1 SGD = 47.62 INR. Find how many Singapore dollars he receives.

The flight from New Delhi to Singapore takes 5 hours and 45 minutes. The distance of the flight is 4150 km. The time in New Delhi when the flight leaves is 21 55. The time in Singapore is 2 1/2 hours ahead of the time in New Delhi. Find the time in Singapore when the flight arrives.
Find the average speed of the aircraft.
On the return flight the average speed is 750 km/h. Find the time of this flight in hours and minutes.
x is proportional to v. Write down an expression for x in terms of v and a constant c.
y is proportional to v^2. Write down an expression for y in terms of v and a constant k.
d = x + y. Write down an expression for d in terms of v, c and k.
Using your answer to part (a)(iii), show that 125 = 2c + 24k.
Write down a second equation connecting c and k.
Solve the simultaneous equations in part (b) to find the value of c and the value of k.
Find the value of d when v = 40.

A ship sails 65 km on a bearing of 310° from A to B. It then changes course and sails 40 km on a bearing of 250° from B to C. The ship then returns to A. On the diagram, sketch the path of the ship from A. On your diagram show the bearings and distances.
Find angle ABC.
Calculate AC and show that it rounds to 91.8 km, correct to the nearest tenth of a kilometre.
Find the bearing of C from A.
Sketch the graph of y = f(x) for -400° ≤ x ≤ 600° where f(x) = 3^{sin x}.
Find the x coordinates of the local maximum points of f(x) for -400° ≤ x ≤ 600°.
The point (30, \sqrt{3}) is on the graph. The point (a, \sqrt{3}) is also on the graph where 600° < a < 900°. Find the two possible values of a.
g(x) = 3 - x/100. Solve the inequality g(x) > f(x).
In the diagram AC = x cm, AB = (x + 2) cm and angle A = 60°. Find an expression, in terms of x, for the area of triangle ABC. Give your answer in surd form.
The area of triangle ABC = 18\sqrt{3} cm^2. Show that x^2 + 2x - 72 = 0.
Solve the equation x^2 + 2x - 72 = 0.
Find the shortest distance between the line AB and the point C.
A is the point (2, 2), B is the point (11, 4) and C is the point (14, 8). Find the equation, in the form y = mx + c, of the line AC.
Find the equation, in the form y = mx + c, of the line through B that is perpendicular to AC.
Show that the point (10, 6) is on both the lines you found in part (a).
AC is the perpendicular bisector of BD. Find the co-ordinates of D.
Find the exact area of the quadrilateral ABCD.

A farmer sorts the grapefruit he grows into sizes, according to their diameter. The diameters, d cm, of 170 grapefruit are shown in the table. Calculate an estimate of the mean diameter of the grapefruit.
On the grid, draw a histogram to represent this information. Complete the scale on the frequency density axis.
Two of the 170 grapefruit are chosen at random. Calculate the probability that they are both Very Large.
Calculate the probability that one is Small and the other is Medium.
Find f(h(2)).
Find x when f(x) = -10.
Write down the range of h(x).
Find f^{-1}(x).
k(x) = 10 - 4x. Describe fully the single transformation that maps the graph of y = g(x) onto the graph of y = k(x).
The graph of y = h(x) is translated by the vector (2 / 0). Find the equation of the graph of the image. Write your answer in the form y = ax^2 + bx + c.
